notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Blood Pet.
You have discarded at least two cards this turn.
description:
Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Blood Pet due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Hollow One by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.
If you have discarded three or more cards this turn, this combo nets infinite black mana.
